mapper.sql: s.id, s.movie_id, m.title AS movie_title, m.poster AS movie_poster, m.duration AS movie_duration, s.cinema_id, c.name AS cinema_name, s.hall_id, h.name AS hall_name, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.base_price, s.total_seats, s.available_seats, s.status, CASE s.status WHEN 0 THEN '可售' WHEN 1 THEN '已结束' WHEN 2 THEN '已取消' ELSE '未知' END AS status_text, s.create_time, s.update_time
FROM showtime s LEFT JOIN movie m ON m.id = s.movie_id LEFT JOIN cinema c ON c.id = s.cinema_id LEFT JOIN hall h ON h.id = s.hall_id
